lesson: META TP proximity demands a pre-committed plan before the open, not real-time improvisation. When a position reaches 0.95R overnight, decide trail-vs-close before market opens to avoid emotional override at fill time.
evidence: META closed $593.48, TP is $594.62 (0.2% away). Historically, failing to pre-commit on near-TP positions leads to either premature exits or missed exits.

lesson: AI chip names with large gap-up opens (>2.5%) routinely fade intraday — hold through the gap fill unless the stop fires. AVGO opened +3.3%, closed flat; thesis unchanged.
evidence: AVGO opened ~$394 (+3.3% vs $382.07 prior close), spent all session fading to $383.50, stop $368.23 never threatened. Premature exit would have been wrong.

lesson: Hold new-entry discipline through major macro events (FOMC). No new positions Tuesday pre-FOMC. Existing stops provide downside protection; GOOGL/MSFT can wait for clarity on Wednesday.
evidence: Missed GOOGL +3.19% and MSFT +2–3% by staying flat, but FOMC hawkish risk is still live. The missed opportunity cost is offset by potential protection if Warsh turns hawkish Wednesday.
